hub.returnBody: That is one stop done. Ready for the next one?

welcome.title: Welcome to AFC!
welcome.body: Esports just means organized competitive gaming, players and teams competing for real. AFC is the home of Free Fire competition in Africa. We will walk you through the site one stop at a time. Just click through, you do not have to do anything on each page. We will carry you all the way to the end.

profile.title: Set up your profile
profile.body: Add your Free Fire UID, in-game name, and esport image so teams and tournaments can find you. A complete profile is your ticket into the action.

uid.title: Add your Free Fire UID
uid.description: Enter your in-game UID here so teams and tournaments can find and verify you.

ign.title: Set your in-game name
ign.description: This is the name people will see across AFC. Make it match your Free Fire account.

save.title: Save your profile
save.description: Save changes lives here when you are ready. No need to fill anything in right now, just click Next to keep the tour going.

esports.title: Add your esport image
esports.description: This is the photo organizers use as your player picture in event graphics, and it powers your shareable profile card. Some events require it. You can add it later, just click Next.

teams.title: Find your squad
teams.body: Create your own team or join one. Squads compete together, climb the rankings together, and win together. Going solo? You can do that too.

create.title: Create your own team
create.description: Start a squad here, name it, set it up, and invite your players.

browse.title: Or browse and join a team
browse.description: Scroll the teams here and tap Apply to Join to ask an existing squad to take you on. You can do this later, just click Next for now.

market.title: Player Market
market.body: Recruit players for your team, or post yourself so teams can recruit you. Think of it as the transfer window, open all year.

create.title: Create a post
create.description: Post here to recruit players for your team, or to put yourself up so teams can recruit you.

tabs.title: Switch between sides
tabs.description: Flip these tabs to see teams that are recruiting, or players who are open to join. Have a look any time, nothing to do here now, just click Next.

tournaments.title: Tournaments and Scrims
tournaments.body: Tournaments are official competitions with prizes and ranking points. Scrims are practice matches to train your team. Jump into either when you are ready.

filter.title: Tournaments versus scrims
filter.description: Tournaments are official competitions with prizes. Scrims are practice matches to train. Switch these tabs to see each.

list.title: Browse and open an event
list.description: Every event lives here. Open one to read the details and register your team whenever you like. For now, just click Done to wrap up the tour.

done.title: You are all set!
done.body: New to the lingo? The Glossary explains every esports term in plain words, anytime you need it. Now go have fun and good luck out there.

marketReport.title: Report this post
marketReport.description: Flagging <subject></subject>. Your report is private and goes to AFC moderators only.
marketReport.detailsPlaceholder: Describe what happened. Include dates, in-game names, and anything a moderator needs to understand the situation.
marketReport.evidenceNote: Attach screenshots or videos as proof. A report cannot be filed without evidence.
marketReport.honestyNote: Report honestly. Filing a false, joke, or untrue report can get you, the reporter, banned from the market. Only report real issues, and attach proof.

bad_tryout.title: Negative tryout experience
bad_tryout.desc: They behaved badly during a trial (no-show, toxic, unfair).

scam.title: Scam or fraud
scam.desc: Asked for money, account details, or tried to deceive me.

abusive.title: Abusive conduct
abusive.desc: Harassment, threats, or hate speech in chat.

fake_post.title: Fake or misleading post
fake_post.desc: Impersonation, fake roster, or false claims.

other.title: Other
other.desc: Something else worth flagging to moderators.

toast.evidenceRequired: Evidence is required. Attach a screenshot before submitting.
toast.success: Report submitted. AFC moderators will review it.
